table.name: hall_of_fame
table.purpose: One row per person per year of consideration for the (baseball) Hall of Fame, recording the voting body, vote counts, and whether the candidate was inducted. The player IDs, categories (Player/Manager/Umpire/Pioneer-Executive), and voting bodies (BBWAA, Veterans Committee) match the classic baseball Hall of Fame dataset.

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Person's ID (e.g. 'roushed01', 'faberre01'), referencing the player table; many rows per person, one per year of candidacy.

col_002.name: year_id
col_002.description: Year of the Hall of Fame ballot/consideration (1936-2016).

col_003.name: voted_by
col_003.description: Voting body or election mechanism: BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association), Veterans Committee, Run Off, Nominating Vote, Old Timers, Special Election, Negro League, Final Ballot.

col_004.name: ballots
col_004.description: Total ballots cast in that year's vote (empty for committee selections without ballots).

col_005.name: votes_needed
col_005.description: Votes required for induction in that election (typically ~75% of ballots; empty when no ballot count).

col_006.name: votes_received
col_006.description: Votes the candidate received in that election; empty for non-ballot selections.

col_007.name: inducted
col_007.description: Y/N flag for whether the candidate was inducted into the Hall of Fame that year.

col_008.name: category
col_008.description: Role for which the person was considered: Player, Manager, Umpire, or Pioneer/Executive.

col_009.name: needed_note
col_009.description: Note on vote-requirement basis, e.g. '1st' (first ballot) or 'Top 20'; empty for most rows. Exact semantics not fully determinable from the data.

table.name: player
table.purpose: Biographical master table of baseball players (Lahman-style People table): one row per player, with birth/death data, names, and physical attributes. Referenced by hall_of_fame, player_award, player_award_vote, and salary.

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Unique player identifier (Lahman playerID format: first 5-6 letters of last name + first 2 of first name + serial, e.g. aaronha01 = Hank Aaron). Primary key, referenced by all other tables.

col_005.name: birth_country
col_005.description: Country of birth (USA, D.R., Venezuela, P.R., CAN, etc.).

col_006.name: birth_state
col_006.description: State or province of birth for US/Canada players (CA, PA, NY...); for other countries holds a region/county name (e.g. Holguin in Cuba, Worcestershire in England).

col_008.name: death_year
col_008.description: Year of death; empty for living players (~half the rows).

col_009.name: death_month
col_009.description: Month of death (1-12); empty for living players.

col_010.name: death_day
col_010.description: Day of month of death (1-31); empty for living players.

col_011.name: death_country
col_011.description: Country of death; empty for living players.

col_012.name: death_state
col_012.description: State/province of death; empty for living players.

col_013.name: death_city
col_013.description: City of death; empty for living players.

col_014.name: name_given_used
col_014.description: Player's commonly used first name or nickname (Lahman nameFirst; includes nicknames like 'Sugar', 'Happy', 'Gabby').

col_016.name: full_given_name
col_016.description: Player's full given name, often first + middle (Lahman nameGiven).

table.name: player_award
table.purpose: Baseball awards won by players (Lahman-style database): one row per player, award, league, and season, listing which award a player received (as opposed to player_award_vote, which records voting results).

col_001.name: player_id
col_001.description: Player identifier (e.g. bondsba01 = Barry Bonds); references player.col_001. Top values are prolific award winners, consistent with a per-award row per player.

col_002.name: award_name
col_002.description: Name of the award received (e.g. Most Valuable Player, Gold Glove, TSN All-Star, Silver Slugger, NLCS MVP).

col_003.name: year
col_003.description: Season/year the award was given; range 1877-2015.

col_004.name: league_id
col_004.description: League the award was given in: AL = American League, NL = National League, ML = Major League (both/all of MLB, e.g. All-Star or overall awards), AA = American Association (19th century league).

col_005.name: tie
col_005.description: Flag indicating the award was shared/tied; 'Y' for tie, empty otherwise. Only 45 rows, consistent with rare tied awards.

col_006.name: notes
col_006.description: Supplementary note about the award, most often the player's position for All-Star selections (OF, SS, 3B, 1B, RF, DH, LHP) or which game/instance (e.g. '1st Game', 'P4' likely 4th pitcher or similar). Empty when not applicable. Exact code meanings beyond positions are unresolved.

table.name: player_award_vote
table.purpose: One row per player per award-vote result: how many points and first-place votes a player received in a given award (MVP, Cy Young, Rookie of the Year) balloting for a league in a season. Corresponds to baseball award voting shares (e.g., Lahman AwardsShare).

col_001.name: award_name
col_001.description: Name of the award being voted on: MVP, Rookie of the Year, or Cy Young.

col_003.name: league
col_003.description: League of the award: AL (American League), NL (National League), ML (both leagues combined, likely pre-league-split or overall awards).

col_004.name: player_id
col_004.description: Player identifier (Lahman-style player ID) referencing player.col_001; the player who received votes.

col_005.name: points_won
col_005.description: Voting points the player received in that award balloting (weighted vote points; 1.0 for the winner in modern MVP voting).

col_006.name: points_max
col_006.description: Maximum possible voting points that season (e.g., 336 for modern MVP with two voters per league city, 140/420 for other eras or awards); the denominator for vote share.

col_007.name: votes_first
col_007.description: Number of first-place votes received. Stored as text; empty string for older rows where first-place votes were not recorded (358 rows).

table.name: salary
table.purpose: Annual player salaries in Major League Baseball: one row per player, team, league and season, giving the salary paid that year (in US dollars).

col_001.name: year
col_001.description: Season year the salary was paid, 1985-2015.

col_002.name: team_id
col_002.description: Three-letter team code of the MLB franchise paying the salary (e.g. KCA = Kansas City Athletics/Royals, NYN = New York Mets, MON = Montreal Expos, SLN = St. Louis Cardinals).

col_003.name: league_id
col_003.description: League the team played in: NL = National League, AL = American League.

col_004.name: player_id
col_004.description: Player identifier (playerID format, e.g. bondsba01 = Barry Bonds); references player.col_001. A player can have many salary rows (one per season/team).

col_005.name: salary
col_005.description: Player's salary for that season, in US dollars (0 to 33,000,000; median 550,000).
